items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I said, well, Sergio, that much of the rest of it.

ctx.x: See, you've got to know. See, because I had an old bass player coming in for the player of the symphony, out here. He said to me, Foster. He said, I've been here every night for a week. Come on, man. You're playing for? What are you doing? I said, well, listen. You'll hear. I'm listening to the piano player. I'm listening to the piano player. I said, I still don't get it. I said, well, Sergio, that much of the rest of it. I said, no. I said, well, you ever listen to that? I said, what they call, I said, what…
They say, I'm par rhythm, what they call antique right now.
